hook: Every night my mom gets a little bit smaller.
caption: Every night my mom gets a little bit smaller… 🕯️ Part 2 tomorrow. #aistory #animation #mom #series (AI-generated, fictional story)
texte: Every night my mom gets a little bit smaller.
Our attic is so cold that my wick almost goes out.
So Mom sits next to me and burns until I'm warm.
One night a rich lady knocks on our door.
She smells Mom and whispers: wax this warm is rare.
For every bowl of wax, she gives Mom three gold coins.
In the morning there are wax drops on the floor.
We finally have soup. And Mom keeps getting smaller.
I ask her why. She just smiles: I'm not cold.
I follow the lady into town. To her shop.
In the window stands Mom. A hundred times. 99 euros each.
Then the lady puts her hand on my head and smiles.
She whispers: and next week… we come for you. Part 2 tomorrow.
